name: Cryptocurrency
description: Cryptocurrency from the Bitcoin paper of 2008 to Bitcoin funds on Wall Street: the coins, exchanges, crashes and ideas.

checkpoints.name: The idea
checkpoints.note: An unknown author called Satoshi Nakamoto publishes the Bitcoin paper. Early users mine coins at home, and one pays 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas.

checkpoints.name: Booms and busts
checkpoints.note: Exchanges are hacked, Ethereum adds programs to the blockchain, and prices soar and crash again and again.

checkpoints.name: Into the mainstream
checkpoints.note: NFTs boom and bust, El Salvador adopts bitcoin, FTX collapses, and in 2024 funds holding bitcoin start trading on Wall Street.
